readings: For each account, use transactions with trans.amount > 2400. Compute the average signed amount using only PRIJEM transactions as +amount and VYDAJ transactions as −amount. Separately, compute the average trans.balance across all transactions with trans.amount > 2400, regardless of type. Return one row with the unrounded average of the account-level signed averages, excluding accounts with no qualifying PRIJEM or VYDAJ transaction, followed by the unrounded average of the account-level balance averages.

For each account, use transactions with trans.amount >= 2400. Compute the average signed amount using only PRIJEM transactions as +amount and VYDAJ transactions as −amount. Separately, compute the average trans.balance across all transactions with trans.amount >= 2400, regardless of type. Return one row with the unrounded average of the account-level signed averages, excluding accounts with no qualifying PRIJEM or VYDAJ transaction, followed by the unrounded average of the account-level balance averages.
queries:
WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
            WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
        END) AS signed_avg,
        AVG(balance) AS balance_avg
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount > 2400
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(signed_avg) AS avg_account_signed_amount,
    AVG(balance_avg) AS avg_account_balance
FROM account_averages

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
            WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
        END) AS signed_average,
        AVG(balance) AS balance_average
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount >= 2400
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(signed_average),
    AVG(balance_average)
FROM account_averages
